cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 7 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
Learn to sail on your schedule with private ASA 101, 103, 104, 103/104 combo, and 114 courses. Get personalized instruction, flexible dates, and focused time on the water so you can build real confidence at your own pace.

ASA 101 - Basic Keelboat
For beginners looking to master fundamentals like sail trim, points of sail, and docking.
*$1,212 - up to 3 students (including ASA certification and log book)*
*$1,616 - up to 4 students (including ASA certification and log book)*

ASA 103 - Coastal Cruising
Move up to larger boats while learning coastal navigation, cruising skills, and boat handling.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 104 - Bareboat Cruising
Become charter-ready with training in boat systems, trip planning, anchoring, and passagemaking.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 103/104 Combination
An efficient way to earn both certifications in one streamlined, private course.
*$3,750 - up to 3 students*
*$5,000 - up to 4 students*

ASA 114 - Cruising Catamaran
Learn to handle cruising catamarans with confidence through hands-on, private coaching.
*$2,250 - up to 3 students*
*$3,400 - up to 4 students*

Book a private course today and start your sailing journey with skills that stick.
highlight_title: Looking to complete multiple ASA certifications at one time?
highlight_description:
NOW AVAILABLE: Bundle multiple courses into one! At check out, select all ASA courses that you would like to complete at one time.

See Activity Details below for pricing.
what_to_bring: We recommend that you bring a hat, sunscreen, sunglasses, light jacket, snacks/lunch, water, and REQUIRE you wear close toed rubber soled shoes. The class will break for lunch for 30 minutes, so bringing a bag lunch is recommended. Our Harbor Island location sells pre-made sandwiches but is based on availability.
special_requirements: All ASA classes have reading material prerequisites. The review questions at the end of selected chapters will cover everything you need to know for the written test on the second day of class. We also recommend to have/bring your ASA log-book, to track your sailing hours and ASA certifications. Both are available at our locations for purchase. You can also purchase your course book online and your local bookstore.
restrictions: Please note all classes may be rescheduled by Seaforth if the minimum number of students is not met, due to inclement weather, or at the discretion of Seaforth Boat Rentals. In the event of forecast inclement weather, we will do our best to notify students at least 24 hours prior to cancellations.

faqs:
Q: How does the $500 deposit work?

A: We take a $500 deposit at the time you submit a private course request. This deposit is fully refundable and will be applied toward the total cost of your course once the dates are scheduled.
